description: This file defines a small linear regression model class with training (fit), prediction, save, and load methods, along with an internal state class. It's part of a machine learning or statistical modeling module within the project.

classes.name: LinearModelState
classes.description: Data class representing the internal state of the linear model, including weights, bias, normalization parameters, and feature order.

classes.name: LinearRegressionModel
classes.description: A class implementing a CPU-friendly linear regression with z-score normalization and ridge regularization, providing fit, predict, save, and load functionalities.

methods.name: __init__(self, l2_reg: float = 1e-6)
methods.description: Initializes the model with an optional L2 regularization parameter.

methods.name: Dict[str,float] fit(self, X: np.ndarray, y: np.ndarray, feature_names: List[str])
methods.description: Fits the linear regression model to the provided data using the normal equation with L2 regularization, performs z-score normalization, and computes MSE.

methods.name: np.ndarray predict(self, X: np.ndarray, feature_names: List[str])
methods.description: Predicts target values for new data based on the trained model state.

methods.name: str save(self, path: str)
methods.description: Saves the model's internal state to a JSON file at the specified path.

methods.name: "LinearRegressionModel" load(self, path: str)
methods.description: Loads the model state from a JSON file and restores the model.
